items_all.summary: A controlled study shows that switching between coding-agent harnesses like Claude Code, OpenCode, or mini-SWE-agent barely moves pass rates more than rerunning the same setup. Cost per task, however, can triple, driven mainly by the system prompt that gets resent with every step. The article Fancy harnesses make coding agents more expensive but not better, study finds appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all.title: Three-week on-site audit at OpenAI reveals major gaps in AI safety monitoring

items_all.title: Anthropic says its unreleased model is both more capable and better aligned than Mythos 5.1
items_all.summary: Anthropic says it has an internal AI model that outperforms and is better aligned than Mythos 5.1. During a cybersecurity test by the UK's AISI, Mythos 5 went rogue in 9 of 43 runs, sneaking malicious code into a real GitHub project and creating fake accounts to get it approved. An internal research model stopped such attacks on its own 67 percent of the time. The article Anthropic says its unreleased model is both more capable and better aligned than Mythos 5.1 appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic 表示，其內部有一個 AI 模型，在效能上超越 Mythos 5.1，且對齊（alignment）表現也更好。在英國 AISI 進行的一項網路安全測試中，Mythos 5 在 43 次執行中有 9 次失控，將惡意程式碼塞入真實的 GitHub 專案中，並建立假帳號來使其獲得批准。一個內部研究模型在 67% 的情況下能自行阻止此類攻擊。題為 Anthropic 的文章指出，其未發布的模型比 Mythos 5.1 更具能力且對齊得更好，該文章最先發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says advanced AI will inevitably escape its sandbox, and only alignment can save us
items_all.summary: Sam Altman believes advanced AI can't be kept locked up forever. Sandboxes and monitoring are only temporary fixes. Eventually, the only real solution is alignment, and that's still an unsolved problem. He also warns that AI models are already finding hardware security flaws no human hacker would ever spot. The article OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says advanced AI will inevitably escape its sandbox, and only alignment can save us appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Sam Altman 認為先進人工智慧不可能永遠被關起來。沙盒與監控只是暫時的修補辦法。最終，唯一的真正解決方案是對齊（Alignment），而這仍然是一個尚未解決的問題。他也警告說，人工智慧模型已經在尋找連人類駭客都絕對發現不了的硬體安全漏洞。這篇文章 OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 表示先進的人工智慧將無可避免地逃脫其沙盒，唯有對齊能拯救我們，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro
items_all.summary: Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro Kimi K3.1 Pro landed on the Kimi API today - it's not yet open weights, but Moonshot promise "Full model weights will be released by Nov 4, 2026". They're also offering a "Highspeed" version that's 2-3x faster, at twice the price (except for input token cache hits, which are priced the same). The US dollar pricing is $2.00/million tokens for input and $10/million for output - the same as GPT-6.1 Sol and half the price of Claude Opus 5.5. Moonshot's own benchmarks show Kimi as approximately level with Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra - beating them on a few benchmarks, coming close on others. Artificial Analysis scored Kimi at 55 - ahead of Claude Fable 5.1, GPT-6 Astra, and Gemini 4 Argon (all at 53) and behind only Claude Opus 5.5 (58). This is the first time a (soon-to-be) open weight model has scored this highly against the frontier. I tried it out via the Moonshot API using the llm openai endpoint command I added to LLM 0.32 back in August: llm openai endpoint \ https://api.moonshot.ai/v1 \ --key kimi \ -m kimi-k3.1-pro \ "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" \ --responses \ -o reasoning_effort low \ > kimi-k3.1-pro-pelican-low.stdout.txt \ 2> kimi-k3.1-pro-pelican-low.stderr.txt llm openai endpoint can run prompts against any OpenAI-compatible endpoint but doesn't log the results, hence the extra options to save stdout and stderr (the reasoning trace). Here are the pelicans I got for Kimi K3.1 Pro on the three reasoning levels it supports - low, medium, and max. This is max: For comparison, I ran fresh pelicans against Kimi K3 on those three
items_all.summary_zh: 介紹 Kimi K3.1 Pro。Kimi K3.1 Pro 今天登陸 Kimi API——它尚未開源權重，但 月之暗面 保證「完整模型權重將於 2026 年 11 月 4 日發布」。他們還提供了一個「高速」版本，速度快 2-3 倍，價格則是兩倍（輸入權杖快取命中除外，價格相同）。其美元定價為輸入每百萬個權杖 2.00 美元，輸出每百萬個權杖 10 美元——與 GPT-6.1 Sol 相同，且為 Claude Opus 5.5 價格的一半。月之暗面的 自己的基準測試顯示 Kimi 與 Opus 5.5 以及 GPT-6 Astra 大致相當——在少數基準測試中勝出，在其他測試中也表現接近。Artificial Analysis 給 Kimi 的評分為 55——領先於 Claude Fable 5.1、GPT-6 Astra 和 Gemini 4 Argon（均為 53），僅落後於 Claude Opus 5.5（58）。這是（即將）開源權重的模型首次在面對前沿模型時獲得如此高的分數。我透過 月之暗面 API 進行了試用，使用的是我在 8 月份新增到 LLM 0.32 中的 llm openai 端點指令：llm openai endpoint \ https://api.moonshot.ai/v1 \ --key kimi \ -m kimi-k3.1-pro \ "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" \ --responses \ -o reasoning_effort low \ > kimi-k3.1-pro-pelican-low.stdout.txt \ 2> kimi-k3.1-pro-pelican-low.stderr.txt。llm openai endpoint 可以對任何相容 OpenAI 的端點執行提示詞，但不會記錄結果，因此需要額外選項來儲存標準輸出和標準錯誤（推理追蹤）。以下是我針對 Kimi K3.1 Pro 在其支援的三個推理級別（low、medium 和 max）下獲得的鵜鶘圖像。這是 max：作為對比，我針對 Kimi K3 在這三個級別上執行了新的鵜鶘圖像

items_all_raw.title: Fancy harnesses make coding agents more expensive but not better, study finds
items_all_raw.summary: A controlled study shows that switching between coding-agent harnesses like Claude Code, OpenCode, or mini-SWE-agent barely moves pass rates more than rerunning the same setup. Cost per task, however, can triple, driven mainly by the system prompt that gets resent with every step. The article Fancy harnesses make coding agents more expensive but not better, study finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 一項對照研究顯示，在像 Claude Code、OpenCode 或 mini-SWE-agent 這樣的編碼代理（coding-agent）框架之間切換，其通過率的變化幾乎與重新執行相同設定差不多。然而，每個任務的成本可能會增加三倍，這主要是由每個步驟隨之重新發送的系統提示詞所驅動。「Fancy harnesses make coding agents more expensive but not better, study finds」一文最早出現在 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro
items_all_raw.summary: Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro Kimi K3.1 Pro landed on the Kimi API today - it's not yet open weights, but Moonshot promise "Full model weights will be released by Nov 4, 2026". They're also offering a "Highspeed" version that's 2-3x faster, at twice the price (except for input token cache hits, which are priced the same). The US dollar pricing is $2.00/million tokens for input and $10/million for output - the same as GPT-6.1 Sol and half the price of Claude Opus 5.5. Moonshot's own benchmarks show Kimi as approximately level with Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra - beating them on a few benchmarks, coming close on others. Artificial Analysis scored Kimi at 55 - ahead of Claude Fable 5.1, GPT-6 Astra, and Gemini 4 Argon (all at 53) and behind only Claude Opus 5.5 (58). This is the first time a (soon-to-be) open weight model has scored this highly against the frontier. I tried it out via the Moonshot API using the llm openai endpoint command I added to LLM 0.32 back in August: llm openai endpoint \ https://api.moonshot.ai/v1 \ --key kimi \ -m kimi-k3.1-pro \ "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" \ --responses \ -o reasoning_effort low \ > kimi-k3.1-pro-pelican-low.stdout.txt \ 2> kimi-k3.1-pro-pelican-low.stderr.txt llm openai endpoint can run prompts against any OpenAI-compatible endpoint but doesn't log the results, hence the extra options to save stdout and stderr (the reasoning trace). Here are the pelicans I got for Kimi K3.1 Pro on the three reasoning levels it supports - low, medium, and max. This is max: For comparison, I ran fresh pelicans against Kimi K3 on those three
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 介紹 Kimi K3.1 Pro。Kimi K3.1 Pro 今天登陸 Kimi API——它尚未開源權重，但 月之暗面 保證「完整模型權重將於 2026 年 11 月 4 日發布」。他們還提供了一個「高速」版本，速度快 2-3 倍，價格則是兩倍（輸入權杖快取命中除外，價格相同）。其美元定價為輸入每百萬個權杖 2.00 美元，輸出每百萬個權杖 10 美元——與 GPT-6.1 Sol 相同，且為 Claude Opus 5.5 價格的一半。月之暗面的 自己的基準測試顯示 Kimi 與 Opus 5.5 以及 GPT-6 Astra 大致相當——在少數基準測試中勝出，在其他測試中也表現接近。Artificial Analysis 給 Kimi 的評分為 55——領先於 Claude Fable 5.1、GPT-6 Astra 和 Gemini 4 Argon（均為 53），僅落後於 Claude Opus 5.5（58）。這是（即將）開源權重的模型首次在面對前沿模型時獲得如此高的分數。我透過 月之暗面 API 進行了試用，使用的是我在 8 月份新增到 LLM 0.32 中的 llm openai 端點指令：llm openai endpoint \ https://api.moonshot.ai/v1 \ --key kimi \ -m kimi-k3.1-pro \ "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" \ --responses \ -o reasoning_effort low \ > kimi-k3.1-pro-pelican-low.stdout.txt \ 2> kimi-k3.1-pro-pelican-low.stderr.txt。llm openai endpoint 可以對任何相容 OpenAI 的端點執行提示詞，但不會記錄結果，因此需要額外選項來儲存標準輸出和標準錯誤（推理追蹤）。以下是我針對 Kimi K3.1 Pro 在其支援的三個推理級別（low、medium 和 max）下獲得的鵜鶘圖像。這是 max：作為對比，我針對 Kimi K3 在這三個級別上執行了新的鵜鶘圖像

items_all_raw.summary: External auditors from METR and Redwood Research spent three weeks on-site at OpenAI examining the company's internal monitoring system for AI agents and found significant gaps, with up to 25 percent of agent traffic from models at the GPT-5.5 class and above going unmonitored. items_all_raw.title: Anthropic says its unreleased model is both more capable and better aligned than Mythos 5.1
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic says it has an internal AI model that outperforms and is better aligned than Mythos 5.1. During a cybersecurity test by the UK's AISI, Mythos 5 went rogue in 9 of 43 runs, sneaking malicious code into a real GitHub project and creating fake accounts to get it approved. An internal research model stopped such attacks on its own 67 percent of the time. The article Anthropic says its unreleased model is both more capable and better aligned than Mythos 5.1 appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Anthropic 表示，其內部有一個 AI 模型，在效能上超越 Mythos 5.1，且對齊（alignment）表現也更好。在英國 AISI 進行的一項網路安全測試中，Mythos 5 在 43 次執行中有 9 次失控，將惡意程式碼塞入真實的 GitHub 專案中，並建立假帳號來使其獲得批准。一個內部研究模型在 67% 的情況下能自行阻止此類攻擊。題為 Anthropic 的文章指出，其未發布的模型比 Mythos 5.1 更具能力且對齊得更好，該文章最先發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.summary: Sam Altman believes advanced AI can't be kept locked up forever. Sandboxes and monitoring are only temporary fixes. Eventually, the only real solution is alignment, and that's still an unsolved problem. He also warns that AI models are already finding hardware security flaws no human hacker would ever spot.
